description: B_obs/|tr_M| across D,T,³He under the canonical Markov trace (include_inter=True). Tests whether the Path-3 single-prefactor binding model B=α_M·|tr_M| has a FORCED universal α_M (= m_e·ρ_binding, constant). Finding: the ratio varies ~189.6% (D 14.64, T 291.0, ³He 131.7), so α_M is NOT a forced constant — the model is a deuteron-anchored approximation that fails at A=3. Scope (a): tr_M as an ingredient is NOT excluded; only the constant-prefactor assumption is refuted. CROSS-VALIDATION WITHDRAWN: this witness used to claim 'the D ratio 5.728 reproduces the published α_M 5.729', which no longer holds — under the interleaved Borromean atom word that `atom_braid_word_3A` emits since qou-hu1f (7db032fb48, owner-ruled 2026-09-05) |tr_M| moves and the D ratio with it. The REFUTATION above is unaffected (it rests on the spread, which stayed large); the agreement with the published α_M is what is gone, and it should not be quoted as a pipeline check until someone re-derives α_M under the corrected word. Bean qou-hu1f.
